About me

I’m currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science (Core) from KIIT University, Bhubaneswar. With a growing interest in Java programming, I’ve been honing my coding skills and continuously exploring how technology can be used to solve real-world problems. While I’m not an expert yet, I’m confident in my foundation and eager to keep improving every day.

Outside the classroom, I’m passionate about football — a sport that has taught me teamwork, discipline, and resilience. I’ve represented my school in interschool competitions and participated in numerous local tournaments, which has helped shape me into a strong team player and a dedicated sportsperson.

In addition to academics and sports, I’ve also gained hands-on experience in the automobile sector by assisting my father in his car sale-purchase business. I’ve successfully closed 8 car deals in just 2 months, developing communication, negotiation, and customer handling skills along the way.

I consider myself a problem-solver with leadership qualities, always open to learning and taking on new challenges. Whether it’s tech, teamwork, or business, I’m driven by a desire to grow and make an impact.
